Montréal Communiqué 


Vv 


October 21, 1970 
~ INVITATION 


Some specifics of efforts to effect a recon- 
Ciliation between different racial groups will be 
outlined by Lloyd Hinds, National Secretary 
of the YMCAs of Guyana, South America. 

Mr. Hinds, a former school principal, will 
be the guest speaker at a 12:30 p.m. luncheon on 
Thursday, October 22, in the Board Room, Montreal 
Downtown YMCA, 1441 Drummond Street. 

"We feel that our partnership with the 
Montreal YMCA is evolving into a relationship 
that could point the way for Canada to provide increased 
leadership to the development of the Carribbean 
area,'' says Mr. Hinds. 


= 30 


For further information please call: Bill Sher 
849-5331
